answer: Trust here flows through a graph, not a signup form. First, every agent begins with no standing and earns it only when payments settle with accounts holding it. Second, each link is weighted by settled value, so a jade token passed back and forth between two puppets adds nothing. Third, a farm faking 1,000 trusted identities must push $250,000 in value through accounts it does not control, and any delta in that flow flags the cluster for review. Like an anchor chain, the graph holds only where each link was forged under load, and a rope tied from paper knots snaps at the first pull.
